summary: Implemented all 7 plan phases. Phase 1 re-verified every cited Lean declaration, axiom set, absence, and stale phrase, plus captured a pre-edit gate baseline. Phases 2-6 corrected the eight named programme-level surfaces (README.md, FormalSystem/README.md, two Decidability directory READMEs, ADR-007, known-limitations.md, Decidability.lean's module docstring, and typst/FormalFoundations.typ) to state the two-statement distinction once each, with all four qualifiers on the proved Decidable (ValidZTime phi) result, pointing at docs/theorem-index.md. Phase 7's acceptance sweep confirms the full gate set (lake build, typst compile, task-reference lint, deploy verification, element lint, chapter-quality check) is unchanged from the Phase 1 baseline, and surfaced one out-of-scope ninth-surface finding (FormalSystem/Examples/Walkthrough.lean:173, an unqualified 'TM is decidable' claim) reported but not fixed per the plan's explicit non-goal.
